messages:
Nora (People Ops): Quick heads-up: the annual attestation window is open for SOC2 + privacy recerts. Deadline for most teams is 2026-04-20. This run is intentionally lightweight: 1) 15-min privacy refresher, 2) the attestation form, 3) upload of 2-4 small artifacts. Read below for team-specific notes and the upload links.

Ben (Security): Can you clarify what counts as an artifact for infra teams? MFA proof, access lists, or rotation logs?

Nora (People Ops): For infra we ask for one of the following (pick the easiest): an SSO admin screenshot showing org-wide MFA enforced, a CSV export of active service principals with last_login, or a signed KMS key-rotation note. All templates here: https://redwood.internal/compliance/annual-2026/templates

Marta (Privacy): Reminder: the privacy refresher changed slightly this year to include data retention policy updates. Everyone must finish the 15-min module by 2026-04-18. Completion auto-records in LMS; contractors need a manager screenshot.

Alex (SRE): For rotation logs, how strict are timestamps? Our rotation job runs monthly but the logs are archived. Is an admin note + a sample log acceptable?

Ben (Security): Admin note + a sample log (redact data) is acceptable. Add a tiny paragraph explaining rotation cadence. That gives auditors the context.

Diego (Eng Manager): A couple folks on my team are OOO 4/15-4/19. Any short extension process?

Nora (People Ops): Yes — file the short exception form: https://redwood.internal/forms/attestation-exception with your manager approval. We review quickly; typical extensions extend deadline by up to 7 days. Please request ASAP.

Luis (CTO): Managers: please ensure your direct reports see this. This matters for our customer contracts and next audit. Happy to jump on a quick sync if a team needs help.

hr-bot: Reminder: contractors must have manager confirmation uploaded by 2026-04-18. If you manage contractors, please add their entries to the contractor sheet linked in the templates.

Marta (Privacy): Small change to evidence types vs last year: if you process third-party data via vendors, include the vendor-dataflow diagram (one slide or a Confluence link) + the latest DPIA note if you have one.

Alex (SRE): Where do we upload artifacts? Drive or Confluence?

Nora (People Ops): Centralized evidence Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/compliance-annual-2026 (use folder <team>/attest/). Add a single line to the tracker sheet noting which artifacts uploaded. If you need write ACLs, ping me.

Diego (Eng Manager): Can the Security team do a quick pre-check before submission? A 10-15 min sanity review would be great.

Ben (Security): Yep — drop a link in #eng-security and we9ll do office-hours spot checks. Office hours: 2026-04-10 10:00-12:00 PT and 2026-04-13 16:00-18:00 PT.

Nora (People Ops): New this year: teams that finish by 2026-04-12 will be entered in a small raffle for a $50 coffee card per team (one winner per team). It's a tiny incentive to finish early. :coffee:

Luis (CTO): Appreciate the incentive. Also appreciate everyone taking a few minutes to get this done. Clear compliance posture helps land larger customers.

Diego (Eng Manager): Uploaded a draft SSO screenshot for my team under /eng/attest/ — request a pre-check.

Ben (Security): Got it, will review in today9s office hours.

compliance-bot: Automated reminder scheduled 1 to 2026-04-12 for teams not started, and final reminder 2026-04-19.
